headlines.statement:
{m n : ℕ} →
  (r : Fin m → ℕ) →
    (c : Fin n → ℕ) →
      (U L : ℕ) →
        (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) →

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount_eq_supportCount
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  1 ≤ L →
    ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportCount r c U X

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrected_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)],
  1 ≤ L →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
        ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U))).mass
              (some X) =
            ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U) /
              ↑(Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrected_success
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)],
  1 ≤ L →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
        1 -
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U))).mass
              none =
          ↑(Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)) *
              ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U) /
            ↑(Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrected_uniform_proportions
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)],
  1 ≤ L →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
        ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
          have law :=
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U));
          law.mass (some X) = (1 - law.mass none) * OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.uniformMass

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_terminalCorrected_success_lower
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
      ∀
        [inst :
          Nonempty
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c
              (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7)],
        let cutoff := 11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2);
        have cellCount :=
          Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c cutoff));
        ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c cutoff) / ↑(2 * (cellCount * (cellCount - 1))) ≤
          1 -
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c cutoff 7
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c cutoff))).mass
              none

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_terminalCorrected_success_positive
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
        (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
          ∀
            [inst :
              Nonempty
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c
                  (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7)],
            let cutoff := 11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2);
            0 <
              1 -
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c cutoff 7
                        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c cutoff))).mass
                  none
